#!/bin/bash
# CPU Monitoring Script
# Samples CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute (12 samples)

LOG_FILE="/workspace/cpu_monitor.log"
SAMPLES=12
INTERVAL=5

# Write header
echo "===== CPU Monitoring Started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') =====" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Function to get CPU usage percentage
get_cpu_usage() {
    # Read /proc/stat for CPU stats
    read -r cpu user nice system idle iowait irq softirq steal _ < /proc/stat
    local total_1=$((user + nice + system + idle + iowait + irq + softirq + steal))
    local idle_1=$((idle + iowait))

    sleep 1

    read -r cpu user nice system idle iowait irq softirq steal _ < /proc/stat
    local total_2=$((user + nice + system + idle + iowait + irq + softirq + steal))
    local idle_2=$((idle + iowait))

    local total_diff=$((total_2 - total_1))
    local idle_diff=$((idle_2 - idle_1))

    if [ "$total_diff" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "0.0"
    else
        awk -v t="$total_diff" -v i="$idle_diff" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f", (t - i) * 100 / t }'
    fi
}

# Take samples
for i in $(seq 1 $SAMPLES); do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    CPU_USAGE=$(get_cpu_usage)
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: ${CPU_USAGE}%" >> "$LOG_FILE"

    # Sleep for remaining interval (minus the 1 second used in measurement)
    if [ "$i" -lt "$SAMPLES" ]; then
        sleep $((INTERVAL - 1))
    fi
done

# Write footer
echo "===== CPU Monitoring Completed at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') =====" >> "$LOG_FILE"
